Grows a safehouse past the walls of the house, a tile at a time. Open the safehouse panel and press Add to Safehouse: you can then click tiles one by one, or drag a box over the whole yard. Anyone who cannot edit it gets View Safehouse instead, which draws the outline so you can see where your boundary runs. A tile can never touch two safehouses, so there is always a gap of one tile between them. Admins can grow anyone's safehouse. Sandbox options decide whether a player can grow their own, and whether new tiles have to touch it at all. Hosted multiplayer and dedicated servers.
LG Extended Safehouses
Extended Safehouses
Admins only
On: only admins can change a safehouse, and they can change anyone's. Everyone else gets View Safehouse, which just draws the outline. Off: a player can change the safehouse they own too.
Tiles must touch the safehouse

On: a new tile has to touch the safehouse you are adding it to. Off: you can put tiles anywhere you like for it. Either way a tile can never touch someone else's safehouse. Changing this leaves tiles you already added exactly where they are.
